method: Every native full-page cluster paired independently to get_texttrace by exact source font/origin, plus every physical table cell on all affected pages. Exact same-font/glyph/origin/bbox/Unicode trace overpaints are enumerated as repeated paints of one physical glyph, without changing source wording. Source ActualText soft hyphens and Unicode ligatures on either extraction API are compared through explicit standard ligature expansions and witnessed at the same physical glyph, never dictionary-corrected. Original Source text is never mutated by witness comparison.
binding: No Source flag activated; proof proposal only during freeze
